name: Delegate
description: Hand the current task to another agent in this session's swarm.

function.name: delegate
function.description: Hand off the current turn to another session member. Call this tool instead of only saying you will delegate — after a successful call the target agent runs immediately and answers the user.

name.description: Target agent display name (alternative to agent_id).

reason.description: What the target should do (include enough detail for them to act without more context).
